name: Bhagyesh Dhamecha
headline: Expert Site Reliability Engineer
tagline: I keep critical healthcare systems fast, available and boring in the best way. 15+ years turning Microsoft and Azure infrastructure into reliable, observable, automated platforms.
about: I'm a Site Reliability Engineer with 15+ years of hands-on experience across the Microsoft technology stack, currently at Altera Digital Health, where uptime directly affects clinicians and patients. My work sits where infrastructure, operations and software meet: defining what "reliable" means, measuring it, and engineering systems to meet it.

I've led incident response for production outages, driven blameless root-cause analysis, and replaced manual runbooks with automation. My foundation is broad, from Windows Server and Active Directory to VMware virtualization, Cisco networking and Microsoft Azure, so I can debug a problem at every layer instead of handing it off.

Today I focus on bringing modern SRE and DevOps practice to established platforms: SLOs and error budgets, observability, infrastructure as code with Terraform, containerization with Docker, and CI/CD. I'm also exploring how AI-assisted engineering can make operations teams faster and safer. This site, containerized and served by nginx, is one of those experiments.
